narrative.overview:
Skin Schema presents beauty content as an enduring collection rather than a disposable feed. Pine surfaces give imagery authority, Warm Bone carries clarity, and Rose guides action without becoming decoration.

The visual language is image-led and flat. Depth comes from Pine 950 and the approved Pine 900 surface exception, full-bleed media, asymmetric overlap, and fine dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Pine 900 and 950 campaign surfaces with restrained Rose accents.
Warm Bone text on dark surfaces and Mineral Pine type on light surfaces.
Large Geist headlines paired with compact Geist Mono labels.
Square image frames contrasted with pill-shaped actions.

rules.name: The Archive Rule
rules.body: Every visual decision must help the work feel worth saving, reusing, and returning to.

rules.name: The Darkroom Rule
rules.body: Pine 950 and the approved Pine 900 exception carry dark surfaces; Bone supplies text. Pine 999 remains a scale endpoint, not a branded surface.

rules.name: The Reversal Rule
rules.body: Light sections use Warm Bone surfaces with Mineral Pine typography.

rules.name: The Rose Rule
rules.body: Serum Pink is for actions and short emphasis; Translucent Rose is for soft fields.

rules.name: The Flat Archive Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest. Distinguish them through tone, boundary, crop, or position before adding shadow.

dos: Do lead with real photography and video.
Do use Pine 950 and the approved Pine 900 exception for dark surfaces.
Do use Pine 750 typography on Warm Bone light surfaces.
Do use Serum Pink for actions, focus, price, and process emphasis.
Do preserve fluid type and spacing from 330px through 1230px.
donts: Don't use Pine 750 as the main dark page surface.
Don't scatter Rose across every heading or section.
Don't use Bone or white text on Serum Pink actions.
Don't use decorative shadows, glass panels, or nested cards.
Don't use floral or spa clichés or imply healing claims.
